The provided text demonstrates compliance with standard cybersecurity policies, specifically the Principle of Least Privilege and the requirement for formal change management. By disabling administrator privileges for standard users, the company minimizes the attack surface and prevents unauthorized modifications to system settings or software, which are common vectors for malware and security breaches. Additionally, requiring a formal request to the IT department ensures that all changes are tracked, reviewed, and approved, maintaining an audit trail and preventing accidental or malicious configuration errors.

The first three months of the year are January, February, and March.
